description: Source code for the LabelPattern class, which handles parsing, matching, and describing label patterns used in build configurations, including wildcard and toolchain specifications.

classes.name: LabelPattern
classes.description: Handles parsing, matching, and describing label patterns with support for wildcards and toolchains.

methods.name: LabelPattern
methods.description: Default constructor, initializes pattern type to MATCH.

methods.name: LabelPattern
methods.description: Parameterized constructor to initialize pattern with type, directory, name, and optional toolchain label.

methods.name: GetPattern
methods.description: Parses a string value into a LabelPattern, handling wildcards, toolchains, and relative paths.

methods.name: HasWildcard
methods.description: Checks if a string contains a wildcard character '*'.

methods.name: Matches
methods.description: Checks if a given Label matches the pattern.

methods.name: VectorMatches
methods.description: Checks if any pattern in a list matches a given Label.

methods.name: Describe
methods.description: Returns a string description of the pattern.
